description: This file is a shell script for testing various features of Git, especially focusing on sparse checkout, sparse index, and related repository operations. It contains setup routines, test cases, and utility functions to verify correct behavior of sparse-related Git commands and configurations.

methods.name: init_repos
methods.description: Initializes multiple repositories in different states for testing, including setting up sparse-checkout configurations and committing initial changes.

methods.name: init_repos_as_submodules
methods.description: Initializes repositories as submodules to test submodule handling in sparse checkouts.

methods.name: run_on_sparse
methods.description: Runs a command in the sparse-checkout directory, passing input from a generated file.

methods.name: run_on_all
methods.description: Runs a command in the full-checkout directory, then also in the sparse-checkout directory.

methods.name: test_all_match
methods.description: Runs a command in both full and sparse checkouts and compares their outputs for consistency.

methods.name: test_sparse_match
methods.description: Runs a command in sparse checks and compares outputs, expecting success or failure.

methods.name: test_sparse_unstaged
methods.description: Checks if a given file path is unstaged in sparse repositories, filtering unmerged paths.

methods.name: test_sparse_checkout_set
methods.description: Sets the sparse checkout directories and verifies sparse directory entries and their states.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs commands, and compares outputs as expected.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a path is missing in the working directory.

methods.name: test_path_exists
methods.description: Checks if a path exists in the working directory.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or outputs.

methods.name: test_region
methods.description: Checks specific regions in trace logs or outputs.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Greps for a pattern inside a file or output.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines into a file or input stream for testing.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates temporary scripts or files used in testing.

methods.name: cat
methods.description: Outputs content to a file or stream.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Function to perform generic tests or assertions.

methods.name: ensure_expanded
methods.description: Verifies that the sparse index has been expanded to a full index.

methods.name: ensure_not_expanded
methods.description: Verifies that the sparse index has not expanded and remains sparse.

methods.name: test_path_is_dir
methods.description: Checks if a path is a directory.
